thesis: Short-term overreaction: in an uptrend, a 3-day RSI below 15 marks forced selling and liquidations that tend to snap back within days. Buy the first up-day, take profit at half the stop distance, and leave after five days regardless.
risks: Dips in a turning market keep falling (2022-style), and all coins trigger together, so losses cluster; the average win is small relative to fees; a high win rate hides tail losses.
